purpose: Human-reviewable classification decisions that OVERRIDE the machine-derived anatomy-system-map. The derived map stays pure and reproducible; every departure from it lives here with its evidence and its reviewer.
notAClinicalReview: This file records ANATOMICAL TAXONOMY decisions only. It has nothing to do with the clinician review of safety rules, shares no queue with it, and must never be merged with it.
rules: A machine-derived class may only be changed to a class an authority states.
An entry with agentProposed true is evidence-backed but NOT human-approved. It may be shown in a spike, visibly marked, and must not be treated as settled.
An entry with no evidence stays UNKNOWN. Absence of evidence is not a licence to infer from a structure's name.

entries.label: Ascending part of right trapezius
entries.rationale: BP3D's own IS-A chain for this concept bottoms out at 'organ zone' and never states a tissue, so the derived map is UNKNOWN. The classification is instead taken from an external nomenclature authority that states it directly, rather than inferred from the word 'trapezius'.

evidence.authority: NCI Thesaurus via EVS Explore (U.S. National Cancer Institute)
evidence.label: Structure of right trapezius muscle
evidence.asserts: The concept is named as a muscle structure; it is cross-referenced to FMA 13419 'Right trapezius' and to SNOMED CT C0224361 'Trapezius Muscle'.

evidence.authority: FMA, as recorded in NCI Thesaurus
evidence.label: Set of superficial extrinsic muscles of right shoulder
evidence.asserts: FMA places the right trapezius in the set of superficial extrinsic muscles of the right shoulder. This is also what makes it a SHOULDER structure rather than a back-only one.

evidence.authority: FMA, as recorded in NCI Thesaurus
evidence.label: Transverse part of right trapezius
evidence.asserts: The transverse part is a has_regional_part of the right trapezius, i.e. the three named parts are siblings under one muscle. This is a sibling part, not the two in question.

entries.evidenceLimit: The NCI concept covers the right trapezius as a whole (FMA 13419) and names the transverse part explicitly. The ascending and descending parts are covered as its sibling regional parts, not as separately coded concepts in this source. A reviewer should confirm the two parts directly in FMA before human approval.

entries.label: Descending part of right trapezius
entries.rationale: Same authority and same reasoning as bp3d:FJ1520. The BP3D IS-A chain states no tissue; the classification comes from the NCI/FMA record, not from the name.

evidence.authority: NCI Thesaurus via EVS Explore (U.S. National Cancer Institute)
evidence.label: Structure of right trapezius muscle
evidence.asserts: Cross-referenced to FMA 13419 'Right trapezius' and SNOMED CT C0224361 'Trapezius Muscle'; FMA places it among the superficial extrinsic muscles of the right shoulder.

entries.evidenceLimit: Same as bp3d:FJ1520: covered as a regional part of the right trapezius, not separately coded in this source. Confirm in FMA before human approval.
